articles.summary: DART low-dose dexamethasone — для high-BPD-risk preterm vent-dependent > 7-10 d. AAP COFN 2010 framework: ≥ 50 % BPD chance.
articles.content:
## История controversial

1990s-2000s: routine high-dose dexamethasone — dramatic ↓ BPD, но ↑ cerebral palsy + cognitive impairment (Yeh 1998 NEJM, Doyle 2014 review). Practice swung к conservative.

2010+ era: **AAP COFN framework 2010** — selective targeted use в highest-risk infants. **DART trial 2006** — low-dose, short-duration safer alternative.

## AAP COFN 2010 framework

Dexamethasone reasonable если:
- Preterm < 28 нед
- На MV ≥ 7-14 d
- Estimated BPD chance ≥ 50 % (используя prediction tools)
- Discuss benefits/risks с family

## Schemes

### DART (Doyle 2006 NEJM, Pediatrics 2014)
**Low-dose schedule (preferred):**
- Day 1-3: 0.075 мг/кг q12h IV (0.15 мг/кг/d)
- Day 4-6: 0.05 мг/кг q12h (0.10 мг/кг/d)
- Day 7-8: 0.025 мг/кг q12h (0.05 мг/кг/d)
- Day 9-10: 0.025 мг/кг q24h (0.025 мг/кг/d)
- **Total dose:** 0.89 мг/кг over 10 days

### High-dose (HISTORICAL — НЕ recommended)
- Hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q6h × 12 d, then taper
- DEX 0.25 мг/кг q12h × 3 d, then taper × 21 d (старый Yeh protocol)

## Hydrocortisone (alternative — controversial)

### PREMILOC 2016 (Baud O, Lancet 387:1827)
- 0.5 мг/кг q12h × 7 d → 0.25 мг/кг q12h × 3 d (low-dose)
- Started early (24-48 h life)
- ↓ BPD modest (6 % difference)
- ↑ Late-onset sepsis у some

### Watterberg 2007 (Pediatrics 120:40)
- Hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q12h
- Не показал survival benefit

## Inhaled steroids — separate evidence

### Budesonide (Bassler NEUROSIS 2015 NEJM)
- 400 мкг inhaled q12h × first month + repeat q6 нед
- ↓ BPD (relative reduction ~10 %)
- НО ↑ mortality (concerning) — controversial

### Yeh 2016 (NEJM 374:2229) — intratracheal
- 0.25 мг/кг intra-tracheal mixed с surfactant
- Effective ↓ BPD у extreme preterm

## Adverse effects

### Acute (during treatment)
- Hyperglycemia
- Hypertension
- GI bleeding (rare у low-dose)
- Adrenal suppression — taper required
- Growth failure
- Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (rare у low-dose)

### Late (long-term concerns)
- Cerebral palsy (high-dose era — ↑ 60 % увеличение risk)
- Cognitive impairment (high-dose)
- ↓ Brain growth (head circumference)
- ↓ Linear growth

**DART low-dose evidence:** acceptable safety profile при targeted use.

## Decision tools

Use BPD prediction calculators (NICHD calculator) — estimate individual risk.

If BPD risk:
- < 35 %: avoid steroids (risks > benefits)
- 35-50 %: individualize
- ≥ 50 %: discuss with family
- ≥ 65 %: steroids likely beneficial

## Calculator Bordik

- neo-bpd-nih (BPD severity)
- neo-dexamethasone-dose (DART scheme)
- neo-budesonide-dose (Yeh / NEUROSIS)
- neo-hydrocortisone-dose (PREMILOC)

articles.title_ru: ECMO у новорождённых — критерии и practice
articles.summary: OI > 40 + потенциально reversible disease. GA ≥ 34 нед, BW ≥ 2 кг. VA ECMO для PPHN/CDH. VV для primary respiratory failure без cardiac.
articles.content:
## Показания (ELSO 2023 guidelines)

### Включающие
- **OI > 40** для 4 ч (сохраняется despite optimal therapy + iNO)
- **OI > 25** для 8 ч в severe MAS / CDH
- **PaO₂ < 40 мм рт ст** > 2 ч
- **pH < 7.15** + lactate > 5 ммоль/л > 2 ч (cardiogenic shock)
- **Failure of pharmacologic therapy** (iNO, sildenafil, milrinone)

### Включающие критерии: gestational + size
- GA ≥ 34 нед
- BW ≥ 2 кг
- Возраст ≤ 14 d (relative — некоторые центры до 28 d)

### Исключающие
- Lethal congenital anomaly
- Severe IVH grade III-IV
- Coagulopathy uncontrollable
- Trisomy 13/18
- Severe brain injury
- > 14 d MV (irreversible lung disease likely)
- Active uncontrolled bleeding

## Типы ECMO

### VA (veno-arterial)
- Both circulatory + respiratory support
- Cannulation: внутренняя ярёмная вена → правое предсердие (drain); правая common carotid artery (return)
- **Preferred для:** PPHN, MAS severe, CDH, sepsis с cardiogenic shock

### VV (veno-venous)
- Только respiratory support (cardiac function preserved)
- Cannulation: dual-lumen IJ catheter (Avalon)
- **Preferred для:** primary respiratory failure без cardiac dysfunction
- Преimущества: preserve carotid (no ligation); higher long-term neuro outcomes

## Cannulation практика

- Под general anesthesia
- Cardiac surgeon involvement preferred
- Heparin loading 100 ед/кг IV pre-cannulation
- ACT goal 180-220 sec на ECMO (некоторые centers 160-180)

## Management на ECMO

### Anticoagulation
- Heparin continuous infusion 20-50 ед/кг/h
- Monitoring: ACT q4h, PTT q12h, anti-Xa weekly
- Bivalirudin alternative при HIT (rare у н/р)

### Ventilation "rest" settings
- PEEP 8-10 см H₂O
- PIP < 25 см H₂O
- Rate 10-20/min
- FiO₂ 0.21-0.30 (lung rest)
- Gentle ventilation prevents barotrauma — recovery

### Sedation + paralysis
- Continuous fentanyl + midazolam
- Paralysis (vecuronium / cisatracurium) для extreme labile

### Monitoring
- Daily heads UZI (IVH detection)
- Continuous SaO₂ pre/post-oxygenator
- Лабораторно q4-6h: ABG, electrolytes, ACT, lactate
- Daily echo (cardiac function recovery)

## Complications

### Bleeding (most common)
- Intracranial 10-20 %
- Cannula site
- GI

### Cannula-related
- Vascular injury (аорта, IJ vein)
- Airway compression (rare, large cannulas)

### Stroke / IVH
- 15-20 % survivors
- Higher у VA (carotid ligation)

### Сепсис
- Cannula-related bloodstream infection
- Antifungal prophylaxis (fluconazole) some centers

## Outcomes (ELSO Registry)

| Cause | Survival к discharge |
|---|---|
| **MAS** | 95 % |
| **PPHN (idiopathic)** | 85 % |
| **Sepsis** | 75 % |
| **CDH** | 50-60 % |
| **Cardiac post-op** | 40-50 % |

**Long-term ND outcomes:** 25-50 % survivors имеют neurodevelopmental impairment (cognitive, motor, hearing).

## ELSO 2023 updates

- Routine cardiac MRI before decannulation
- Anti-Xa target 0.3-0.7 (instead of just ACT)
- Bivalirudin для HIT/heparin sensitivity
- VV preferred when cardiac function permits (long-term carotid preservation)

## Калькуляторы Bordik
- neo-resp-indices (OI/OSI calculation — gateway к ECMO criteria)
- neo-ino-dose (pre-ECMO trial)
- neo-sildenafil-dose

- Cochrane Neonatal ECMO 2008:CD001340 — meta-analysis
- Smartt LF et al. **Pediatr Crit Care Med 2024;25:e218** — VV vs VA neonatal

articles.summary: Antenatal Dx → стабилизация перед surgery. Gentle ventilation, permissive hypercapnia. iNO + ECMO при PPHN. Repair после стабилизации.
articles.content:
## Определение

CDH — porок развития диафрагмы с migration abdominal organs в thoracic cavity, ведущим к pulmonary hypoplasia + persistent pulmonary hypertension of newborn (PPHN).

## Epidemiology

- 1 / 2500-3000 livebirths
- Left-sided 80-85 % (Bochdalek hernia)
- Right-sided 10-15 %
- Bilateral 1-2 % (lethal)

## Pathophysiology

1. Failure pleuroperitoneal canal закрытия (8-12 нед gestation)
2. Abdominal viscera (intestines, stomach, spleen, sometimes liver) → thorax
3. Compression developing lungs → pulmonary hypoplasia (BOTH sides — contralateral эффект)
4. Aberrant pulmonary vascular development → PPHN
5. Cardiac displacement (mediastinum shift)

## Antenatal management

### Diagnosis
- Routine 18-20 нед anatomy УЗИ
- Visualization stomach в chest, mediastinal shift
- Confirmation: fetal MRI
- LHR (Lung-to-Head Ratio) — predictor severity
  - LHR < 1.0: severe (mortality > 70 %)
  - LHR 1.0-1.4: moderate
  - LHR > 1.4: mild
- O/E LHR (observed/expected) — refined predictor

### Antenatal interventions
- **FETO (Fetal Endoscopic Tracheal Occlusion)** — TOTAL trial 2021 NEJM
  - Severe CDH: ↑ survival (40 % vs 15 %)
  - Risk preterm birth
- **Counseling** — multidisciplinary (perinatology, neonatology, surgery)
- **Delivery в специализированном center** с ECMO availability

## Postnatal management — "gentle approach"

### Резonimация в родзале
1. **Avoid bag-mask ventilation** — gas в stomach worsens compression
2. **Immediate intubation** — orotracheal
3. **OG decompression** large bore (10-12 Fr)
4. **Pre-ductal SpO₂** monitoring
5. **Avoid manual hyperventilation**

### NICU stabilization (gentle ventilation)
- **Permissive hypercapnia** PaCO₂ 50-60 (pH > 7.25)
- **Permissive hypoxemia** SpO₂ 85-95 % pre-ductal
- **PIP < 25** (high baromtrauma risk у hypoplastic lungs)
- **HFOV** при failure conventional
- Sedation + paralysis if necessary
- Surfactant — controversial, limited benefit (NOT routine)

### PPHN management
- iNO 20 ppm (controversial — NEONIH 2019 показал no benefit у CDH specifically)
- Sildenafil PO 0.5-2 мг/кг q6h
- Milrinone 0.25-0.75 мкг/кг/мин
- ECMO criteria — OI > 40 sustained

### Stabilization criteria до surgery
- pH > 7.25
- PaO₂ pre-ductal > 60 мм рт ст
- Lactate < 4 ммоль/л
- MAP > 50
- iNO weaning или off
- Stable vasopressor support
- Off ECMO ideally (some centers operate on ECMO)

## Surgical repair

### Timing
- **Delayed repair** (после стабилизации, 24-72 ч typically) — preferred
- **Old practice (immediate repair)** — abandoned: high mortality

### Approach
- **Open thoracotomy** — standard
- **Open laparotomy** — alternative
- **Thoracoscopic / minimally invasive** — emerging (selected stable patients, CO₂ insufflation tolerance)

### Repair technique
- **Primary repair** (small defects ~30 %)
- **Patch repair** (large defects ~70 %): Gore-Tex / Surgisis / autologous muscle flap
- Closure stomach ± spleen / left lobe liver reduced into abdomen

## Outcomes (CDH Study Group registry)

| Severity | Survival к discharge |
|---|---|
| **Mild** | 90 % |
| **Moderate** | 70-80 % |
| **Severe** | 30-50 % |
| **Severe + ECMO** | 50-65 % |

### Long-term morbidity
- BPD (chronic O₂ dependence) 20-50 %
- Pulmonary hypertension persistent 5-15 %
- GERD 50 % (fundoplication 30 %)
- Recurrent hernia 5-15 %
- Neurodevelopmental impairment 15-40 %
- Failure to thrive 30 %
- Skeletal anomalies (chest wall, scoliosis)

- neo-ino-dose, neo-sildenafil-dose

- AAP COFN, AAP Surgery Section. **Pediatrics 2008** — CDH guidelines
- Tracy ET et al. **Ann Thorac Surg 2010;90:1326** — Patch repair outcomes

articles.summary: TSH screen 24-72 h. Levothyroxine 10-15 мкг/кг/d ASAP при confirmed. Без treatment — irreversible cognitive impairment.
articles.content:
## Эпидемиология

- 1 / 2000-4000 livebirths (range varies — higher в эндемичных йод-deficiency areas)
- 2:1 female:male
- Без лечения: severe cognitive impairment, growth failure (cretinism — historical term)

## Этиология

### Permanent (most common)
- **Thyroid dysgenesis** 75-85 %:
  - Aplasia / agenesis 33 %
  - Ectopic (sublingual) 33 %
  - Hypoplasia 33 %
- **Dyshormonogenesis** 15-25 %:
  - TPO defect (most common)
  - TG defect
  - Pendred syndrome (PDS gene + sensorineural hearing loss)
  - DUOX2 / DUOXA2 defects

### Transient (6-15 % cases)
- Iodine deficiency / excess (maternal)
- Maternal antithyroid drugs (PTU, methimazole)
- Maternal blocking antibodies (TBAb)
- Hereditary TBG abnormalities

### Central (rare, 1-2 %)
- TSH deficiency (pituitary)
- TRH deficiency (hypothalamic)
- Часть panhypopituitarism

## Скрининг

### TSH-based (most common, including РФ + Europe)
- Sample 24-72 ч жизни (sensitive)
- TSH > 20 mU/L: presumptive positive
- Confirm с serum TSH + Free T4
- Treatment ASAP (до day 14)

### T4-based + reflex TSH (US — partly historical)
- T4 < 10th percentile → reflex TSH
- Detects central hypothyroidism

### Cut-offs РФ
- TSH > 9 mU/L на скрининг → recall
- > 18 mU/L → urgent confirmation + treatment start

## Confirmation

- Serum TSH + Free T4 + Total T4
- TSH > 20 mU/L + Free T4 < 12 пмоль/л → CONFIRMED CH
- Borderline cases — repeat at 1-2 нед или treat empirically

### Аdditional workup
- Thyroid УЗИ (presence + size + position)
- Tc-99m / I-123 scan (etiology — if available)
- TBAb если materinal autoimmune disease
- Genetic testing (familial cases, dyshormonogenesis suspected)

## Treatment

### Levothyroxine (T4)
- **Start dose:** 10-15 мкг/кг/d PO once daily
- **Severe (TSH > 50, Free T4 undetectable):** 15 мкг/кг/d
- **Moderate (TSH 20-50):** 12 мкг/кг/d
- **Goal:** **Free T4 в upper-normal range; TSH normalized**
  - Free T4: 17-23 пмоль/л (1.4-2.3 нг/дл)
  - TSH < 5 mU/L

### Administration
- Tablet crushed + small water или breast milk
- Empty stomach (avoid soy, calcium, iron — interfere absorption)
- Same time каждый day

### Monitoring
- TSH + Free T4 в 2 нед after start
- Every 2 нед × 6 нед
- Every 1-2 мес × 6 мес
- Every 3 мес × 1 год
- Every 6 мес × следующие 1-2 года
- Every 12 мес thereafter

## Outcomes

### С early treatment (≤ 14 d жизни)
- IQ normal (compared to siblings)
- Growth normal
- Reduced learning disabilities — но subtle deficits в processing speed, math

### Late treatment (> 4 нед)
- IQ ↓ 5-10 points
- Learning disabilities
- Speech / motor delays

### Без treatment
- Severe cretinism (irreversible cognitive impairment)
- Growth failure
- Goiter (только при dyshormonogenesis)

## Re-evaluation после 3 yr

- Если transient suspected (mild, иод-related, materinal antibodies):
  - Trial of treatment cessation × 4-6 нед
  - Re-test TSH + Free T4
  - If normal — confirm transient
